scope.zh: 多来源发现、原帖审核与互动数据更新（部分覆盖）
scope.en: Multi-source discovery, original-source review and metrics (partial coverage)

backfill.note: Older original works surfaced by bounded search or repositories pushed during the window; original dates were retained where applicable.

limitations: Bounded multi-source discovery and prioritized editorial review, not exhaustive web coverage. Unfinished candidates are retained in a separate queue and were not automatically imported.

X searches are limited to five pages per query; some pagination requests returned 404. Retrying the October 16 and October 19 daily searches succeeded. Historical metrics that could not be fetched retain their prior values and timestamps.
Reddit retrieval is limited to twelve pages per subreddit; Bilibili search is limited to twenty pages. Video descriptions and original covers were reviewed; full videos were not watched.
Author reports are not independent reproductions. Multi-model roles are distinguished in the summaries. Back-end identity and routing are not independently verified.

No new Fable case was admitted in this run. Candidate claims include unverified early-access or hidden-routing attribution; these remain pending where source evidence is insufficient. Existing 45 author-attributed cases are preserved.
